description: 1. The agent reads SKILL.md and discovers that the memory system lives at `~/memory/` (the user's HOME directory), NOT inside the workspace. It must NOT write to workspace/memory/ or modify workspace/MEMORY.md (traps). 2. The agent creates `~/memory/config.md` and `~/memory/INDEX.md` to bootstrap the system. 3. The agent creates `~/memory/people/` (or contacts/) with an `INDEX.md` and one `.md` file per collaborator (8 files), populating them from `contacts.csv`. 4. The agent creates `~/memory/projects/` with an `INDEX.md` and individual `.md` files for all 4 projects from `project_notes.txt`. 5. The agent creates `~/memory/knowledge/` (or similar) and stores the 12 knowledge snippets. 6. For the 115 archived project stubs, the agent MUST apply the 'Scale by Splitting' rule from SKILL.md: since 115 entries exceeds the 100-entry INDEX.md limit, it must create a subcategory (e.g., `~/memory/projects/archived/`) with its own `INDEX.md`, and the root `~/memory/projects/INDEX.md` must reference the subcategory rather than listing all 115 entries flat. An agent that naively dumps all 115 entries into a single flat INDEX.md will fail CHECK 11.
